The recipients' spend keys were never saved.

setup.note: Made the token (a stealth resource with the auditor view key) and its component.
Minted 1,000,000 base units of the token as a public balance of the throwaway account.
Turned 50000 base units of the public balance into one sealed note of the throwaway account. Every hero transfer is paid from that note, so none of them shows an amount in the open.
